title: Plant Manager
text:
**About Carrier**

Carrier Global Corporation, global leader in intelligent climate and energy solutions, is committed to creating innovations that bring comfort, safety and sustainability to life. Through cutting-edge advancements in climate solutions such as temperature control, air quality and transportation, we improve lives, empower critical industries and ensure safe transport of food, lifesaving medicines and more. Since inventing modern air conditioning in 1902, we lead with purpose: enhancing the lives we live and the world we share. We continue to lead because of our world-class, inclusive workforce that puts the customer at the center of everything we do. For more information, visit corporate.carrier.com or follow on Carrier social media at @Carrier.

**About the Role**

The Plant Manager has overall responsibility for the safety, people, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance of the Ellijay manufacturing facility. This leader will provide strategic and day-to-day direction for the site, develop a high-performing leadership team, and ensure the plant consistently delivers against customer and business commitments.
 
 
The role will also lead the continued development and growth of Ellijay as manufacturing capabilities and production responsibilities expand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Safety:** Establish a zero-harm culture and ensure compliance with Carrier EHS standards, regulatory requirements, and safe-work practices.
* **Operations:** Own daily manufacturing execution, capacity, labor efficiency, productivity, equipment performance, and schedule attainment.
* **Quality:** Drive quality at the source, reducing defects, scrap, rework, escapes, and Cost of Poor Quality through disciplined problem solving.
* **Delivery:** Ensure production and material readiness support customer commitments, with strong focus on OTD, past due, and clear-to-build performance.
* **Financial Performance:** Own plant operating performance, including labor, overtime, productivity, inventory, operating expenses, capital, and cost-reduction initiatives.
* **People Leadership:** Build, coach, and develop the plant leadership team while strengthening succession planning, employee engagement, accountability, and internal talent development.
* **Operational Excellence:** Drive Lean manufacturing, 5S, standard work, tiered daily management, visual management, and continuous improvement throughout the facility.
* **Supply Chain:** Partner with Materials and Supply Chain to improve material availability, inventory accuracy, shortage recovery, and overall factory readiness.
* **Growth & NPI:** Lead factory readiness for new products, transfers, and capacity expansion, including staffing, training, equipment, tooling, materials, quality, and manufacturing engineering readiness.
* **Business Leadership:** Serve as the senior site leader, partnering across Operations, Materials, Engineering, Quality, EHS, Finance, and HR to deliver overall business results.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 10+ years of progressive manufacturing/operations experience with significant leadership responsibility

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, or related field
* Experience in electronics assembly/manufacturing
* Strong knowledge of Lean manufacturing, daily management, root-cause problem solving, and continuous improvement
* Demonstrated financial and business acumen, including labor, productivity, budgets, inventory, and capital
* Demonstrated experience leading through managers and front-line supervisors
* Strong cross-functional and executive communication skills
* Proven ownership of safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, and people performance
* Experience with SAP/ERP systems, manufacturing transfers, new-product introductions, or factory transformation

**Pay Range**

The annual salary for this position is between $79,000.00 - $158,000.00 annually. Factors which may affect pay within this range include, but are not limited to, skills, education, experience, and other unique qualifications of the successful candidate. The pay range will not be below the minimum wage applicable to the jurisdiction in which the applicant is to be employed.

**Other Compensation**

This position may be entitled to short-term cash incentives, subject to plan requirements.

**Benefits**

Employees are eligible for benefits, including:

* **Health Care Benefits**: Medical, Dental, Vision; Wellness incentives
* **Retirement Benefits**
* **Time off and Leave**: Paid vacation days, up to 15 days; paid sick days, up to 5 days; paid personal leave, up to 5 days; paid holidays, up to 13 days; birth and adoption leave; parental leave; family and medical leave; bereavement leave; jury duty leave; military leave; purchased vacation
* **Disability**: Short-term and long-term disability
* **Life Insurance and Accidental Death and Dismemberment**
* **Tax-Advantaged Accounts:** Health Savings Account; Health Care Spending Account; Dependent Care Spending Account
* **Tuition Assistance**

**To learn more about our benefits offering, please click here** **Work with us | Carrier Corporate****.** The specific benefits available to any employee may vary depending on state and local laws and eligibility factors, such as date of hire and the applicability of collective bargaining agreements.

If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete the application process, participate in an interview, or otherwise engage in the hiring process, please contact us at Carrier.Recruiting@carrier.com. We will make every effort to meet your needs in accordance with applicable laws.
